questionText:

Assertion (A): Harmony (Unity) is the ultimate goal achieved when all elements and principles of design work together to create a unified whole.
Reason (R): When an ensemble possesses harmony, every part contributes to an overarching central theme without discordance or visual conflict.

In the light of the above statements, choose the correct answer from the options given below:

options.text: Both (A) and (R) are true and (R) is the correct explanation of (A)

options.text: Both (A) and (R) are true but (R) is NOT the correct explanation of (A)

Both (A) and (R) are true, and (R) correctly explains (A). Harmony is the synthesis of unity and variety where every design detail complements the central aesthetic concept.
